column1: # Ceilings for scripts/footprint.sh --check, in bytes above the baseline image.
# Set on 2026-11-07 at 5 percent above the figures measured at a2cf8ada with rustc 1.92.0,
# rounded up to a whole KiB. A change that needs more raises the ceiling in the same pull
# request, so the growth is reviewed rather than discovered. A toolchain bump is a
# re-baseline, recorded with the new figures. The custom configuration has no ceiling.
